summary.text: A child aged 10 to 15 years, described as Caucasian, had a histologically determined hypothalamic pilocytic astrocytoma and underwent proton beam therapy six months after partial tumor resection. A ventriculoperitoneal shunt produced an imaging artifact. Baseline MRI showed a hyperintense, partially resected mass of 41.3 cm^(3) with two adjacent cysts.

Proton beam therapy was delivered in 30 daily fractions to a total of 54 Gy and was well tolerated. Structural and diffusion MRI sessions at baseline and 9, 17, 24 and 30 days after treatment start showed a stable tumor volume with a T2w signal increase, a rise in fluid voxels at t1 with falling FA and FAt and rising MD and FW in solid voxels, then smaller fluid-voxel changes while the solid-voxel trend progressively inverted.

At the 8-month follow-up (t5), the T2w signal remained high, the tumor volume increased to 44.7 cm^(3), and fluid voxel number and diffusivity increased. Vomiting, headache and ideomotor slowing at t5 were effectively treated with corticosteroids. The authors suggested possible tumor pseudoprogression, and the normal-appearing white matter showed changes strongest near the tumor.

ambiguities.issue: Table 1 reports whole-tumor medians (including fluid voxels) and changes relative to baseline, whereas the Results text reports solid-voxel changes and a t5 versus t4 comparison (for example MD +23.6%, FW +30.7%, DTI-FA -34.9%, FWI-FAt -3.3%). The text values and table values are different measurements and are not merged. The DTI-FA and FWI-FAt sentence cites Table 1, but Table 1 prints neither -34.9% nor -3.3%, and the sentence states no region or time of its own; the reference point of the solid-voxel MD and FW percentages is also not stated.

evidence.quote: In the solid voxels at t5, there were increases both in the MD (+23.6%) and in the FW (+30.7%). The DTI-FA decreased by 34.9%, and the FWI-FAt decreased by 3.3% (Table 1).

Each diffusion index reports the median value of the distribution within the whole tumor volume (including fluid voxels), the relative change of the median with respect to baseline (∆) with its 1st (Q1) and 3rd (Q3) quartile values.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not equate text percentages with Table 1 entries or assign a time or region to the FA and FAt decreases.

ambiguities.issue: In the parsed table text each Q1/Q3 cell of Table 1 shows two numbers run together (for example 0.1040.214, 0.10.181). The original article XML prints each cell as two values separated by a line break, Q1 above Q3, so the split recorded in the quartile facts follows that printed break, not a digit-count convention. The measurement series excludes these cells because its cells come from the run-together text.

caption_evidence.quote:
Figure 2
Longitudinal effects from baseline (t0) and at t1 = 9, t2 = 17, t3 = 24, and t4 = 30 days after PBT treatment start. (A) Volumes of tumor mass (grey), overall FW (light blue), fluid voxels (dark blue). (B) Percent changes with respect to t0 of tumor solid voxels median values and (C) their distributions. (D) Mapping of fluid voxels (blue) on tumor 3D renders (grey). Note: ns: not significant, **: p < 0.01, ****: p < 0.0001. The p-values were Bonferroni corrected for longitudinal comparisons and the four diffusion indices.

article_limitations: Retrospective imaging case report with sparse clinical history; sex, exact age, symptoms before treatment and tumor grade are not stated.
Table 1 reports whole-tumor medians whereas the text reports solid-voxel changes; the two are kept as separate observations.

The supplementary ZIP (one 10-page PDF: planning dosimetry, Table S1 acquisition parameters, Figures S1 to S5 and Table S2 NAWM values) is reviewed in its own supplement sidecar; its typed facts are supplemental, not article facts. Its Figure S3 and S5 legends print different upper dose limits for NAWM2 (48.7 Gy and 48.6 Gy); these are image-printed values and are not recorded as facts or as a conflict.
Figure captions are author statements; pixels were inspected separately in visual.json.
Figure 2 caption lists t0 to t4 while the panels also print t5; panel content is described in visual.json.
